issues: structure_files check description falsely claims 'all fields non-empty, and all numeric fields must parse as finite decimal numbers' — the actual check_structure implementation only validates file presence, empty-file, header match, and ragged rows. Non-empty/finite-numeric enforcement lives in check_cell_meta (unique_nonempty for cell_id), check_umap and check_de (to_floats), not in check_structure. This mismatch caused the markers-numeric-nonfinite probe control to fail (structure_files passed where the annotation expected it to fail; passed_control: false in the executed control record). Fix by either implementing the claimed validations in check_structure or correcting the structure_files check description, then re-executing all controls on the revised candidate; any affected probe annotations must then match the fresh grader behavior.
rationale: The grader's binary acceptance behavior is scientifically sound: all eight wrong-result probes are correctly rejected (categorical corruption, cell-set trims, tolerance-boundary score perturbations, non-finite values, ordering violation, missing gene row, cluster-splitting, UMAP coordinate swap/shift), while the reference, recomputed, independent-solution and valid representation-probe submissions all pass. Source coverage of eligible scientific endpoints is complete (four Leiden solutions, level-1 annotation, UMAP, full per-cluster Wilcoxon DE table), every exclusion is source-backed, and the scrublet/QC exclusions are causally inert, which is empirically confirmed by the byte-identical cell_metadata.csv between the reference and independent runs. Answer isolation is verified: the oracle input tree contains only the two hash-verified matrices, reference answers live only in the oracle-inaccessible reference projection, and the 12,089-file installed-distribution scan found no answer fixture. However, one defect must be repaired before packaging: the structure_files check's public requirement claims validations ('all fields non-empty, all numeric fields parse as finite decimals') that its implementation does not perform — directly evidenced by the failed markers-numeric-nonfinite control, where structure_files passed although the probe annotation expected it to fail. This check-description/implementation mismatch is repairable within the existing candidate without changing science, tolerances, or endpoint scope (either implement the claimed validations in check_structure or correct the check description), but requires fresh re-execution of all controls. Hence revise, not blocked.

comparisons.rationale: The full one-vs-rest Wilcoxon DE endpoint matches between the reference (scanpy float32 storage) and an independent float64 reimplementation of the documented formulas (column-wise ranks, z = (W - n1(n+1)/2)/sqrt(n1*n2*(n+1)/12) without tie correction, two-sided normal-approximation p-values, BH FDR per group over the full gene universe, log2FC from expm1 of group/rest means of log-normalized data with 1e-9 added). The tolerances are anchored in the observed float32/tie-ordering noise envelope and straddled by calibrated probes; the group column is the distinct leiden_res_0.50 label set, keeping the identity mapping consistent across dependent outputs (cross_file_consistency).

source_coverage.rationale: Every eligible terminal scientific result of the source notebook is covered: the four Leiden clusterings (default resolution-1 n_iterations=2 plus resolutions 0.02/0.50/2.00), the level-1 annotation through the fixed five-entry map on leiden_res_0.02, the 2-D UMAP embedding, and the per-cluster one-vs-rest Wilcoxon DE table over the full retained-gene universe. Exclusions are source-backed and causally inert: scrublet (operates on an internal copy and writes only doublet_score/predicted_doublet obs columns consumed solely by excluded QC-reassessment plots; empirically confirmed by the byte-identical cell_metadata.csv between the reference run, which executed scrublet, and the independent run, which did not), QC metrics/flags (consulted for judgment, not filtering — the only executed filters are min_genes=100/min_cells=3, which are retained), the raw-counts layer (no reader after normalization), PCA/variance-ratio/HVG annotation/neighborhood graph (intermediate representations whose products are exported downstream), and all sc.pl.* calls (presentation-only). The line-312/314 rank_genes_groups_df head(5) previews are display slices of the already-exported DE table, not separate endpoints. The public brief states the shared methodology (steps 1-8) faithfully, including the occurrence-rank cell_id rule that the reference execution demonstrably exercises (non-unique obs warning in the oracle stderr; 20 suffixed ids present in the reference). One grader-level defect exists (structure_files check description claims non-empty/finite-numeric validations that check_structure does not implement, evidenced by the failed markers-numeric-nonfinite control where structure_files unexpectedly passed); it is recorded in the top-level issues list and does not concern source endpoint coverage, so it is not listed here.
